newsitem.title: USA: US Wats signs pact with Bell Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: US Wats signs pact with Bell Atlantic.

text.p: US WATS Inc said Thursday it signed five interconnection agreements with Bell Atlantic Corp that will allow US WATS to compete as a local exchange carrier to business customers.

"This agreement establishes USWI as a significant player in the Mid-Atlantic states where we have targeted as our primary territory for offering bundled local and long distance services to commercial accounts," said Kevin O'Hare, president and chief executive of US WATS.
The five agreements cover New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, and the District of Columbia.
